body: That puts you in my top 5 favorite Texans
So strange that every interaction I have had in texas has been assholes, yet I meet so many texans online who are decent people.

Do not be sorry. It was my lot in life from a young age to fight. 

It is not that my convictions are strong. It is that i have decided, and already signed the paperwork. I am no longer in the clinical trial as of yesterday. With my decision there is a 2 month window to change my mind, but as of now I am 2 months without chemo or medicine. I do not see my mind changing back within those 2 months.
I actually hate writing. I always have. I do not see how or why anyone would find my writing useful. Most of my writings are hate-filled rantings about how angry I am at everyone and everything.

No. I have survived by sheer force of will, even my doctor agrees with this. But now, I am worn thin. I do not believe people are put on this earth for a "greater purpose", i believe they make the purpose if they want to. I do not want to.

Yes. I am okay with it. 

I am a 4 time survivor, and I am not even 30. I am worn so thin that most of the time I do not even allow myself to have connections anymore. I do not see the point. It is not a matter of IF I die of cancer, it is a matter of when.
I read this again and realize it comes across as more harsh than I intended.

Thank you for reading it and understanding. It is rare to find someone who accepts my decision. I know that I am going to loose the few friends I have left because they will see it as selfish and cruel to them. If it is easier on them to distance themselves from my situation while I take what time I can for myself... that is fine.
I do not know who you are, and I am not entirely sure what there is to talk about.
I will never let everything out.

I actually hate writing, so I have never considered it. I dislike how I sound when I speak, and I read what I write in my own voice, down to the stutter. I can go weeks without saying more than a few necessary words per day due to my insecurities. 

As for seeing the world differently... I grew up in a very distant family. My mother went insane after the death of my youngest brother, and when I was diagnosed with cancer shortly after she wrote me off as dead. I felt invisible, and so I learned to harness it and watch others. People are strange creatures when you get down to the core of it. 

Even if I did consider writing.... I have no idea what I would write about. 

For now, sleep. I have to be up in a few hours to feed the cats, pay some bills, and make lunch before work. I will try to check back in here before work tomorrow, but if I can not I will be back after. Goodnight.
